detail.en-US: Announcement-event reconstruction delays eligibility; full historical revision visibility remains incomplete.
detail.zh-CN: 公告事件重建延迟可用时点；完整历史修订可见性仍不完整。

detail.en-US: Observed-version collection is prospective; current downloads cannot restore original historical versions.
detail.zh-CN: 观测版本采集面向未来，当前下载无法还原历史原始版本。

detail.en-US: Industry/control checks qualify the archived panel, not independently dated all-market eligibility.
detail.zh-CN: 行业与控制检查覆盖归档面板，不等于独立定时的全市场资格。

detail.en-US: Terminal settlement and unresolved held-price gaps remain open.
detail.zh-CN: 终止事件结算与持仓价格缺口仍待解决。

detail.en-US: After the BSE event-code join, one original monthly sequence completes; 59 retain price gaps and ten lack growth formations. Formal validation remains blocked.
detail.zh-CN: 北交所停牌代码对齐后，1 条原月频序列完成，59 条仍有价格缺口，10 条缺少研发增长建仓月份。正式验证继续阻断。

detail.en-US: Fixed-fee stress is diagnostic; fills, impact and independent dividend cash flows are absent.
detail.zh-CN: 固定费用压力测试仅作诊断，缺少成交、冲击与独立股息现金流证据。

data_version.en-US: Separate historical execution follow-up, reviewed 2026-10-03; existing 90/80 and corrected 77/66 signal samples are retained unchanged.
data_version.zh-CN: 独立的历史执行后续核对，复核于 2026-10-03。原 90／80 和修正后的 77／66 信号样本保持不变。

missing.en-US: A source entry or artifact hash does not certify a complete rerun; original availability, dependencies and historical eligibility must match.
missing.zh-CN: 来源入口或产物哈希不等于完整复跑认证；原始可得性、依赖和历史资格必须一致。

resume_when.en-US: Resolve held-price and terminal gaps and dated eligibility before portfolio promotion; keep the prospective holdout sealed.
resume_when.zh-CN: 解决持仓价格、终止事件和定时资格缺口后再评估组合；前瞻留出继续封存。

action.en-US: Resolve held-price and terminal gaps and dated eligibility before portfolio promotion; keep the prospective holdout sealed.
action.zh-CN: 解决持仓价格、终止事件和定时资格缺口后再评估组合；前瞻留出继续封存。

acceptance.en-US: Retain an immutable audit with the named evidence gap resolved; preserve the previous decision if the gate fails.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留不可变审计并解决上述证据缺口；门槛未通过则保留原判断。

action.en-US: Paired uncertainty, annual / size slices and calibration retained under the fixed retrospective follow-up.
action.zh-CN: 已按固定回溯方案保留配对不确定性、年度／规模切片与校准记录。

acceptance.en-US: Hashes and original cohort/metric reproduction checks passed; no executable return claim.
acceptance.zh-CN: 哈希与原始样本／指标复现检查通过，不声称可执行收益。

action.en-US: Align explicit BSE suspension identities and preserve the original replay comparison.
action.zh-CN: 对齐北交所明确停牌的代码，保留与原回放的对照。

acceptance.en-US: Same-date events only; one diagnostic completes and nine advance. No quote imputation or assumed settlement.
acceptance.zh-CN: 仅连接同日事件，1 条诊断完成，9 条推进。缺价与未知结算均保留。

action.en-US: Run a separate common-start diagnostic from the first sufficiently covered growth month.
action.zh-CN: 按研发增长首次覆盖充分的月份运行独立共同起点诊断。

acceptance.en-US: 77 formations for all seven arms; growth has no missing formations but all ten growth sequences retain price gaps. Original twelve missing months remain missing.
acceptance.zh-CN: 七个变体均使用 77 个建仓月份。增长建仓完整，十条增长序列仍有价格缺口。原始缺失的十二个月继续保留。

action.en-US: Keep the prospective October 2026–September 2027 holdout sealed.
action.zh-CN: 继续封存 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月的前瞻留出。

acceptance.en-US: All registered labels must mature and independent evidence gates must pass before performance is read.
acceptance.zh-CN: 全部登记标签成熟、独立证据门槛通过后，才具备读取表现的资格。

diagnostic_note.en-US: Retrospective paired diagnostics: monthly circular blocks of 12 for R&D; issuer resampling within one year for forecast errors. For an R&D-minus-value or R&D-minus-inverse-size interval that spans zero, the sample cannot establish which association is stronger; this does not prove equal effects. These intervals do not remove exploratory selection, incomplete financial revisions or market-time dependence. Positive forecast MAE differences mean worse errors.
diagnostic_note.zh-CN: 回溯配对诊断：研发使用 12 个月循环区块；预测误差按年度内公司重采样。若“研发减估值”或“研发减逆规模”的区间跨零，表示样本无法判断哪种关联更强，不代表已证明效果相同。区间不能消除探索选择、不完整财报版本或市场时间依赖；预测 MAE 差值为正表示误差更大。
